name: navigation-menu
behavior: APG disclosure-navigation pattern inside a nav landmark (links are links, never menuitems: role=navigation on the root, a plain list of items; a parent item's trigger is a button with aria-expanded + aria-controls on its panel; Left/Right when horizontal — Up/Down when vertical — move between top-level items, Home/End jump; Enter/Space toggle a panel, Down moves into the open panel, Esc closes it and returns focus to its trigger; Tab always leaves the menu; the current destination carries aria-current=page)

parts.note: present only on items that own a panel; items that are plain destinations render the link part instead
marks the current destination: bottom edge when horizontal, inline-start edge when vertical; filled themes may express it as an interaction-selected fill on the link instead — same slot
free content region, not a menu: it hosts grouped links, descriptions, promos

anatomyNotes: Intersection of shadcn NavigationMenu (horizontal, viewport-hosted panels) and Salt NavigationItem + VerticalNavigation (which carries orientation, active, expanded, parent as first-class props). shadcn's shared `viewport` — one animated box the panels swap through — is a RECIPE/positioning device, not a part: it exists only to cross-fade sibling panels and disappears when viewport={false}, so the anatomy keeps the panel attached to its item. Salt's MegaMenu is this anatomy with a full-bleed panel recipe. This is NOT anatomy/menubar.json: no roving menuitem semantics, no typeahead, links stay links.
